mapper.sql: id, order_num, vin, state, outbound_order_num, loading_line, delivery_time, receipt_time, `lock`, description, create_time, create_by, modify_time, modify_by, row_version, row_valid
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tb_transport_order_detail ( order_num, vin, state, outbound_order_num, loading_line, delivery_time, receipt_time, `lock`, description, create_time, create_by, modify_time, modify_by, row_version, row_valid ) VALUES
( #{item.orderNum}, #{item.vin}, #{item.state}, #{item.outboundOrderNum}, #{item.loadingLine}, #{item.deliveryTime}, #{item.receiptTime}, #{item.lock}, #{item.description}, now(), #{item.createBy}, now(), #{item.modifyBy}, 1, 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_transport_order_detail t SET t.state = #{state}, t.outbound_order_num = #{outboundOrderNum}, t.loading_line = #{loadingLine}, t.delivery_time = #{deliveryTime}, t.receipt_time = #{receiptTime}, t.`lock` = #{lock}, t.description = #{description}, t.modify_time = now(), t.modify_by = #{modifyBy}, t.row_version = t.row_version + 1 WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.row_valid = 1
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_transport_order_detail t WHERE t.row_valid = 1 AND t.order_num = #{orderNum} ORDER BY t.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_transport_order_detail t SET t.row_valid = 0, t.modify_time = now() WHERE t.order_num = #{orderNum} AND t.row_valid = 1
